# OpenWeatherMap Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill with read-only access to weather: current conditions and a 5-day forecast for any city, in metric units. It only reads weather data — it never writes, modifies, or sends anything. Honest notes: new API keys can take up to 2 hours to activate after creation; temperatures are always reported in Celsius; the forecast returns 3-hour slots. OpenWeatherMap has a free tier. Draft: written from OpenWeatherMap's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
